note: CD3pos: T lymphocytes — vertical band at high CD3 (CD3+), spanning a broad SSC-A range; the CD3-low cluster on the left is excluded. CD3 is bimodal — boundary set at the valley between the CD3- and CD3+ peaks.
tips: Positive selection of T cells on pre-gated Live singlet lymphocytes. CD3pos: CD3+ (pan-T marker). SSC-A on y serves as a scatter sanity check — CD3+ events should fall in the canonical lymphocyte scatter range.
